content: Contrary to results observed on benchmark GLUE tasks, we observe XLNet consistently outperforming RoBERTa. To confirm this observation, we apply these models to the negation detection and scope resolution task, and observe a continuity in this trend, reporting state-of-the-art results on three of four datasets on the negation scope resolution task.
